items.stemEn: I don't buy coffee. I want to ____ money for a trip.
items.stemZh: 我不買咖啡，我想存錢去旅行。

items.stemEn: I can't ____ on my homework. My brother is playing music.
items.stemZh: 我沒辦法專心寫功課，我的兄弟在放音樂。

items.passageEn: Today was a bad day. I missed the bus, so I walked to work. At the office, I dropped my coffee on the clean floor. Then I had a fight with my friend about a small thing. In the evening, I listened to music and felt better. I must focus on the good things.
items.passageZh: 今天很糟。我錯過了公車，只好走路上班。到了辦公室，我把咖啡打翻在乾淨的地板上。接著我又為了一件小事和朋友吵架。晚上我聽了音樂，覺得好多了。我要專注在好的事情上。

questions.questionZh: 說話者為什麼走路上班？
晚上說話者做什麼讓自己好過一點？

items.promptZh: 可以幫我把杯子倒滿嗎？
referenceEn: Can you fill my cup, please?
rubricZh: 「把⋯倒滿」可用 fill＋容器（例如 fill my cup；寫 fill my cup with tea、fill up my cup 也正確）
請求可用 Can you…?、Could you…?、Please… 等

referenceEn: She misses her hometown very much.
rubricZh: miss 表示「想念」，直接接受詞（例如 misses her hometown）
「很」可寫，例如 very much、really、a lot 等
